title: DaVinci Notes Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for DaVinci Notes plugin manifest.json files

version.description: Plugin release version adhering to SemVer 2.0.0.

description.description: Short description of the plugin's capabilities.

main.description: Relative path to entry JavaScript file inside the plugin folder.

isDesktopOnly.description: Whether the plugin requires desktop-specific capabilities.

permissions.description: Capability-scoped permissions requested by the plugin.

authorUrl.description: Optional author homepage, repository, or profile URL.

license.description: Optional SPDX license identifier (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0).

styles.description: Optional relative path to CSS stylesheet within the plugin directory.

keywords.description: Optional keywords for discovery in the plugin registry.
